text:
The session fixed the one finding in `regeneration-failures.spec.md` that the hand-off named. Its intent, though, lists gaps G1 to G8, and the visible turns never touch them. The intent text is cut off, so I can't tell whether those gaps belong to this retry or to an earlier attempt.

- **Repeated edit:** turn 13 edits the spec before the matched lines are inspected (turns 14-15) and before the hand-off is read (turns 18-19). Turn 20 then makes another edit of the same size, 237 chars, so the first edit was probably redone. The hand-off is also read twice in a row (turns 18 and 19), at 530 and then 527 chars.
- **Unresolved placeholder:** the intent still contains `⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`. The prompt was rendered with an unfilled setting.
- **Conformance:** the header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, so there is nothing to grade.
